# SEO Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Make rashaydaya.co.za rank at the top of Google for branded searches like "Rashay Daya" and "rashaydaya.co.za".

**Architecture:** All changes are in Next.js App Router conventions — metadata in `layout.tsx`, auto-generated `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt` via route handler files, and a dynamic OG image via `opengraph-image.tsx`. No new dependencies required.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 14 App Router · TypeScript · `next/og` (built-in)

---

## File Map

| Action | File | Responsibility |
|--------|------|----------------|
| Modify | `src/app/layout.tsx` | Fix domain, add canonical, add WebSite JSON-LD, add GSC verification placeholder |
| Create | `src/app/sitemap.ts` | Generates `/sitemap.xml` at build time |
| Create | `src/app/robots.ts` | Generates `/robots.txt` at build time |
| Create | `src/app/opengraph-image.tsx` | Generates branded OG image at `/opengraph-image` |

## Task 1: Fix domain + add canonical + add WebSite JSON-LD in `layout.tsx`

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/layout.tsx`

- [ ] **Step 1: Update `metadataBase` and all URL references from `rashaydaya.dev` → `rashaydaya.co.za`, add `alternates.canonical`, add `verification` placeholder, and add `websiteJsonLd`**

Replace the entire `metadata` export and `jsonLd` + new `websiteJsonLd` in `src/app/layout.tsx`:

```ts
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  metadataBase: new URL('https://rashaydaya.co.za'),
  title: 'Rashay Daya — DevOps & Full Stack Developer',
  description:
    'DevOps & Full Stack Developer. Building resilient CI/CD pipelines, distributed infrastructure, and full-stack systems at scale. Johannesburg, South Africa.',
  keywords: [

    'CI/CD',

    'Rashay Daya',
    'Johannesburg',
  ],
  authors: [{ name: 'Rashay Daya' }],
  creator: 'Rashay Daya',
  alternates: {
    canonical: 'https://rashaydaya.co.za',
  },
  verification: {
    google: '', // Paste your Google Search Console token here after verifying
  },
  openGraph: {
    type: 'website',
    locale: 'en_ZA',
    url: 'https://rashaydaya.co.za',
    siteName: 'Rashay Daya — Technical Vanguard',
    title: 'Rashay Daya — DevOps & Full Stack Developer',
    description:
      'Infrastructure-to-interface ownership. CI/CD pipelines, distributed systems, full-stack applications.',
  },
  twitter: {
    card: 'summary_large_image',
    title: 'Rashay Daya — DevOps & Full Stack Developer',
    description:
      'Infrastructure-to-interface ownership. CI/CD pipelines, distributed systems, full-stack applications.',
  },
  robots: {

      'max-video-preview': -1,
      'max-image-preview': 'large',
      'max-snippet': -1,
```

Note: The `images` arrays are removed from `openGraph` and `twitter` — `opengraph-image.tsx` (Task 4) wires the OG image automatically.

## Task 2: Add `sitemap.ts`

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/sitemap.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the file**

```ts
// src/app/sitemap.ts
import { MetadataRoute } from 'next'

export default function sitemap(): MetadataRoute.Sitemap {
  return [
    {
      url: 'https://rashaydaya.co.za',
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 1,
    },
  ]
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Verify sitemap renders**

With the dev server running:

```bash
curl http://localhost:3000/sitemap.xml
```

Expected output (XML containing `rashaydaya.co.za`):
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">
  <url>
    <loc>https://rashaydaya.co.za</loc>
    ...
  </url>
</urlset>
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Commit**

```bash

git commit -m "feat(seo): add sitemap.xml via Next.js App Router"
```

## Task 3: Add `robots.ts`

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/robots.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the file**

```ts
// src/app/robots.ts
import { MetadataRoute } from 'next'

export default function robots(): MetadataRoute.Robots {
  return {
    rules: {
      userAgent: '*',
      allow: '/',
    },
    sitemap: 'https://rashaydaya.co.za/sitemap.xml',
    host: 'https://rashaydaya.co.za',
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Verify robots.txt renders**

```bash
curl http://localhost:3000/robots.txt
```

Expected:
```
User-Agent: *
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://rashaydaya.co.za/sitemap.xml
Host: https://rashaydaya.co.za
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Commit**

```bash

git commit -m "feat(seo): add robots.txt via Next.js App Router"
```

## Task 4: Create dynamic OG image

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/opengraph-image.tsx`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the file**

```tsx
// src/app/opengraph-image.tsx
import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og'

export const runtime = 'edge'
export const size = { width: 1200, height: 630 }
export const contentType = 'image/png'

export default function OGImage() {
  return new ImageResponse(
    (
      <div
        style={{
          background: '#111418',
          width: '100%',
          height: '100%',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          padding: '80px',
        }}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            color: '#FF5F1F',
            fontSize: 24,
            fontFamily: 'monospace',
            marginBottom: 16,
            letterSpacing: '0.15em',
            textTransform: 'uppercase',
          }}
        >
          rashaydaya.co.za
        </div>
        <div
          style={{
            color: '#E2E8F0',
            fontSize: 72,
            fontWeight: 800,
            lineHeight: 1.1,
            marginBottom: 20,
          }}
        >
          Rashay Daya
        </div>
        <div
          style={{
            color: '#94A3B8',
            fontSize: 28,
          }}
        >
          DevOps & Full Stack Developer
        </div>
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            bottom: 64,
            left: 80,
            color: '#94A3B8',
            fontSize: 18,
            fontFamily: 'monospace',
            opacity: 0.6,
          }}
        >
          Johannesburg, South Africa
        </div>
      </div>
    ),
    { ...size }
  )
}
```

## Task 5: Google Search Console setup (manual)

This task requires browser interaction — cannot be automated.

- [ ] **Step 1:** Go to [https://search.google.com/search-console](https://search.google.com/search-console)
- [ ] **Step 2:** Click **Add property** → choose **URL prefix** → enter `https://rashaydaya.co.za`
- [ ] **Step 3:** Choose **HTML tag** verification method → copy the `content` value (looks like `abc123xyz...`)
- [ ] **Step 4:** Open `src/app/layout.tsx` and paste the token:

```ts
verification: {
  google: 'PASTE_YOUR_TOKEN_HERE', // replace with actual token
},
```

- [ ] **Step 5:** Deploy the site (or run locally if using tunnel)
- [ ] **Step 6:** Back in Search Console → click **Verify**
- [ ] **Step 7:** Navigate to **Sitemaps** → enter `https://rashaydaya.co.za/sitemap.xml` → click **Submit**
- [ ] **Step 8:** Commit the token update

```bash
git add src/app/layout.tsx
git commit -m "feat(seo): add Google Search Console verification token"
```
